title: Wallet Options
description: Understanding PayDeck wallet configuration modes: manual address, seed phrase, and xPub import.
text: wallet wallet options paydeck supports four wallet configuration modes, each with different tradeoffs between simplicity, privacy, and security. watch-only wallet paydeck is a watch-only wallet. it generates receiving addresses and monitors for payments, but cannot spend funds . when you enter a seed phrase, paydeck derives only the public keys (xpub) for address generation, then immediately discards the seed quick comparison mode privacy complexity best for manual address (“enter address”) simplest quick setup, testing generate seed (“create wallet”) medium recommended import seed (“restore wallet”) existing wallet import xpub (“import xpub key”) advanced developers the names in quotes are the rows on the device. “high” privacy is what a seed or xpub wallet makes possible, not what you get by default: privacy is a switch in wallet settings and starts off, so one address is reused until you turn it on. a fixed address entered earlier with “enter address” also stays in use while privacy is off. which should i choose? ready to configure your wallet? we recommend starting with seed generation for the best balance of security and privacy. quick setup (manual) low high pros cons setup guide enter a single nexa address directly. all payments go to this address. create a new 12- or 24-word bip39 seed phrase on the device from tap entropy, with an optional passphrase. this enables hd (hierarchical deterministic) address derivation for privacy mode. enter an existing seed phrase of 12 to 24 words, with its passphrase if it has one. paydeck derives the xpub and discards the seed immediately after. the device never stores private keys. enter an extended public key (xpub) directly. maximum security as the seed never touches the device. advanced option with limited wallet support. no privacy, but works in seconds recommended for most users consolidate payments to existing wallet maximum security, requires technical setup >manual address <span classname= >import seed <span classname= >import xpub <span classname= simplest setup: just enter an address no seed phrase to back up no privacy: all payments publicly linked anyone can see your total received no address derivation capability can use a new address for every payment once privacy is switched on full control of key generation can recover wallet with seed phrase must securely back up seed phrase seed shown only once: if lost, cannot recover takes a minute or two of tapping to collect entropy use addresses from existing wallet consolidates payments to known wallet must enter seed on device (briefly exposed) requires trust in device firmware seed phrase never touches paydeck full privacy mode support most wallets don't support xpub export 141-character key in paydeck's own format, typed by hand, with no checksum i want the easiest setup possible i'm new and want security + privacy i already have a nexa wallet i'm a developer or advanced user

title: Generating a Seed
description: Create a new 12- or 24-word BIP39 seed phrase on PayDeck from human tap entropy.
text: wallet generating a seed generate a new 12- or 24-word bip39 seed phrase for privacy-preserving payments. this is the recommended setup for most users. how it works paydeck generates your seed phrase, displays it once for you to write down, then derives the public keys (xpub) needed for address generation. the seed is then immediately erased from memory . paydeck never stores your seed or private keys. isolated environment during seed generation, paydeck creates a secure, isolated environment: wifi disabled during seed creation no computer required - any usb power works wifi switched off watch-only - no private keys stored paydeck has no security chip because it doesn't need one - it never stores wallet secrets (seed, passphrase or private keys). only your xpub (public keys) remains after setup. before you begin prepare the following before starting: critical warning your seed phrase will be shown only once . after you verify it and answer the passphrase question, paydeck derives the public key, erases the seed and restarts. if you don't write it down correctly: you cannot recover it from the device no support can help retrieve a lost seed you will lose access to all received payments setup steps while tapping: taps closer together than a tenth of a second are ignored where and in what rhythm you tap does not change the seed tip: dice can help you spread your taps: divide the screen into 6 zones, roll, tap in that zone. they do not add randomness to the seed, which comes only from sensor noise. learn more about entropy → • use pen (not pencil) • write clearly and legibly • double-check each word • number the words don't • take a photo • save digitally • email to yourself • store in the cloud if you get one wrong: the device shows “incorrect word” and stays on that word, so correct it and continue. tapping back discards this seed. what's stored: only your xpub (public keys for address generation). private keys and seed phrase are never stored on the device. storing your seed safely recovery your seed phrase is the master key to your funds (together with the passphrase, if you added one: the words alone then restore a different, empty wallet). if your paydeck is lost, stolen, or damaged: your seed phrase follows the bip39 and bip44 standards with nexa's path m/44'/29223'/0', so you're not locked into paydeck. a recovery wallet must title: Seed Verification
description: Verify your seed phrase was recorded correctly using Wally Wallet.
text: wallet seed verification verify your seed phrase is correctly recorded by recovering it in a companion wallet. this also gives you full wallet functionality when needed. why verify your seed? paydeck erases your seed phrase immediately after setup. if you wrote it down incorrectly, you won't discover the mistake until you try to recover your funds, potentially years later. by then, it's too late. common mistakes misspelled words (e.g., "acount" vs "account") wrong word order similar-looking words (e.g., "car" vs "card") illegible handwriting recommended: wally wallet we recommend using wally wallet to verify your seed phrase. by recovering your seed in wally, you verify it works correctly and gain access to full wallet functionality. a full-featured nexa wallet for ios and android. same wallet as paydeck, with complete functionality for managing your funds. download wally wallet paydeck + wally: the complete setup verification steps if any word is rejected: check your written notes carefully. you may have a spelling error or wrong word. addresses match? your seed is correctly recorded. both wallets are viewing the same funds. what you gain with wally once recovered in wally, you have the same wallet on two devices with complementary features: security note your seed phrase gives full access to your funds. only enter it on trusted devices and apps. wally wallet is open source and widely used in the nexa community. never enter your seed on websites or unverified applications. other compatible wallets your seed also works with other bip39-compatible wallets: otoplo multi-platform wallet with social features visit → seed verified?
